# Miauterm 0.1.2-coral

This release uses Coral as its codename.

- Reduce vertical spacing in Settings rows while keeping the dark, flat interface.
- Improve contrast for Cancel and other neutral dialog actions.
- Open the Miauterm GitHub issue form directly from Settings > Updates & Support.
- Fix Android lint annotation imports so the app compiles in GitHub Actions.

The release includes signed ARM64 APKs and SHA-256 checksums. Install on Android 7.0 or newer with an ARM64 processor.
